description:
METL: Every superhero needs a secret formula to unlock their powers. Three explorers on one mission: making every child the hero of their own story.

🕹️ Mohamed: Game Architect: Crafting immersive gaming experiences.

🔬 Malak: Science Seeker: Leading research and scientific validation.

🧠 Adham Nader: Neuro-Mind: Applying neuroscience to learning design.

We blend science, creativity, and Art to turn learning into an epic adventure.

Three Superpowers. One Magic Potion. Every Child a Hero.
